origine_fr: En bas, un fil de soie 糸 ; autour, 微 raccourci, qui donnait le son mais se lit wēi, loin de huī. Au départ, 徽 est une bande de tissu cousue en biais. Cette bande portée comme marque est devenue l'insigne, 徽章.
origine_en: At the bottom, a silk thread 糸; around it, a shortened 微, which gave the sound but is read wēi, far from huī. At first, 徽 is a strip of cloth sewn on a slant. That strip worn as a mark became the badge, 徽章.

phrase.pinyin: Tā de bāo shang yǒu yī gè huīzhāng.
phrase.fr: Il y a un badge sur son sac.
phrase.en: There's a badge on his bag.
